title: Museum Skip-Line QR
scenario: A QR outside a museum sells skip-line tickets at a discount.

answers.A: Scan and pay because the queue is getting longer.
answers.B: Buy tickets from the museum or its verified ticket partner.
answers.C: Scan the QR but check the final URL only after entering your card.
answers.D: Ask the museum desk whether the QR and seller are official.

explanation: Queues create urgency, but a QR code does not identify the seller. Verify with the museum before paying.
proTip: The queue is inconvenient; losing card details is worse.
